families.unit_evidence: Lists Runtime tests cover row geometry, palettes, target and keyboard behavior, and large text. Retained roving tests cover a clipped reorder, caller scrolling and focus fallback after multiple removals. Core paint and Mac AccessKit projection have focused tests. Multi-select tests cover retained focus, checked state, disabled and missing actions, passive checkbox paint, role projection and distinct native checkbox actions. Multi-action tests cover direct siblings, independent commands, 48 dp targets, narrow reflow, four-arrow focus, zero-size fallback and native accessibility actions. Expandable list tests cover inline height, disabled children, visual focus reveal, user scrolling, motion reversal, modal scope and stale actions. The macOS projection test checks expanded state and distinct child focus and press. Point drag tests read the latest rendered layout through rebuild. Reorder tests cover explicit focus fallback, the fixed barrier, edge scroll then release, stale revision and 48 dp targets.
